title: How TradesStation Works | Free, No-Obligation Quotes
description: How TradesStation helps you find local builders and tradespeople: describe your job, compare quotes and hire the right person. Free, with no obligation.
cardText: Describe your job, compare quotes, hire with confidence
intro: TradesStation is a free guide and introduction service for homeowners. We help you understand your job, then point you to trusted quote platforms so you can hear from local tradespeople.

sections.html: Yes. Using TradesStation and requesting quotes through our partners is free for homeowners, with no obligation to hire.

Some links on TradesStation are referral links. When we introduce you to a partner platform, that partner may pay us a fee. This never changes the price you pay a tradesperson. Read more about how we make money.

Tradespeople are independent businesses listed with our partner platforms. TradesStation does not employ, endorse or vet individual tradespeople, so always make your own checks. Our hiring guide explains how.
